help.short: The name of the load balancer.
The name of the load balancing rule.

description: Get the specified load balancer load balancing rule.

operations.description: Gets the specified load balancer load balancing rule.

params.description: The name of the load balancer.
params.name: loadBalancerName

params.description: The name of the load balancing rule.
params.name: loadBalancingRuleName

params.description: The name of the resource group.
params.name: resourceGroupName

params.description: The subscription credentials which uniquely identify the Microsoft Azure subscription. The subscription ID forms part of the URI for every service call.
params.name: subscriptionId

props.description: A unique read-only string that changes whenever the resource is updated.
props.name: etag

props.description: Resource ID.
props.name: id

props.description: The name of the resource that is unique within the set of load balancing rules used by the load balancer. This name can be used to access the resource.
props.name: name

props.description: Properties of load balancer load balancing rule.
props.name: properties

props.description: A reference to a pool of DIPs. Inbound traffic is randomly load balanced across IPs in the backend IPs.
props.name: backendAddressPool

props.description: An array of references to pool of DIPs.
props.name: backendAddressPools

props.description: The port used for internal connections on the endpoint. Acceptable values are between 0 and 65535. Note that value 0 enables "Any Port".
props.name: backendPort

props.description: Configures SNAT for the VMs in the backend pool to use the publicIP address specified in the frontend of the load balancing rule.
props.name: disableOutboundSnat

props.description: Defines whether connections between 2 communicating endpoints can be tracked and associated to the same backend VM over its lifetime when using UDP protocol.
props.name: enableConnectionTracking

props.description: Configures a virtual machine's endpoint for the floating IP capability required to configure a SQL AlwaysOn Availability Group. This setting is required when using the SQL AlwaysOn Availability Groups in SQL server. This setting can't be changed after you create the endpoint.
props.name: enableFloatingIP

props.description: Receive bidirectional TCP Reset on TCP flow idle timeout or unexpected connection termination. This element is only used when the protocol is set to TCP.
props.name: enableTcpReset

props.description: A reference to frontend IP addresses.
props.name: frontendIPConfiguration

props.description: Resource ID.
props.name: id

props.description: The port for the external endpoint. Port numbers for each rule must be unique within the Load Balancer. Acceptable values are between 0 and 65534. Note that value 0 enables "Any Port".
props.name: frontendPort

props.description: The timeout for the TCP idle connection. The value can be set between 4 and 30 minutes. The default value is 4 minutes. This element is only used when the protocol is set to TCP.
props.name: idleTimeoutInMinutes

props.description: The load distribution policy for this rule.
props.name: loadDistribution

props.description: The reference to the load balancer probe used by the load balancing rule.
props.name: probe

props.description: The reference to the transport protocol used by the load balancing rule.
props.name: protocol

props.description: The provisioning state of the load balancing rule resource.
props.name: provisioningState

props.description: Type of the resource.
props.name: type
